about.title: Building for real people, in two languages.
about.p1: I'm Moad Almshirem, a software engineer based in Libya. I build mobile apps with Flutter and web products with React, TypeScript and Next.js, usually with the backend and data layer alongside them.
about.p2: Most of what I ship is Arabic-first and bilingual, so right-to-left layouts, Arabic typography and localization are part of how I work rather than an afterthought.

focus.mobile: Flutter apps with clean architecture, Riverpod and offline-first data
focus.web: React and Next.js products with careful typography and motion
focus.backend: APIs, Firebase and SQL data models that stay consistent
focus.i18n: Arabic / English localization and RTL done properly
